prompt_md: Two friends each arrive at a café at a random moment between 9:00 and 10:00, independently, and stay exactly 30 minutes. What's the chance they're there at the same time?
prompt_short: Two friends arrive at random within an hour and stay 30 min. Chance they meet?
hint_md: When do they miss each other?
explain_intuition_md: Picture the two arrival times as a point in a square. They only miss each other when the arrivals are more than half an hour apart, which is two corner triangles covering a quarter of the square. The other three quarters are meetings.
